before_claims.title: NS0031 norm-one modular obstruction with unresolved rational K3 marking
before_claims.scope: For the literal NS0031 transcendental Gram [[0,0,4],[0,74,1],[4,1,-2]], the retained split even Clifford order has norm-one curve Gamma_ns(4) intersect Gamma_0(37), of index 304 and genus 23. Its elliptic counts are (0,4) and cusp widths (4,4,148,148). Velu's rational-point classification of X_0(37), together with the exact prime-19 Frobenius pair (2,3) absent from the full nonsplit mod-4 Cartan, proves that this norm-one fibre product has no noncuspidal rational point, including after quadratic twist. The claimed application to full rational NS0031 K3 markings is withdrawn: EC-K3-NS0031-PERIOD-GROUP-COUNTERWITNESS exhibits an integral stable reflection outside the rational norm-one image, refuting the recorded group containment and the period-induced map deduced from it. Existence of a K3 over QQ with the full rational NS0031 marking remains UNKNOWN. The formal ZZ_7 branch, finite-field precursor, bounded rational-coordinate scan and geometric F017 corridor retain only their respective local or geometric scopes. The remaining gate is the actual full stable projective period group, its model over QQ and its rational non-CM locus, or another exact arithmetic obstruction. The finite arithmetic checker proves neither this missing map nor the external global rational-point theorem.
dependencies: external: J. Velu, Les points rationnels de X_0(37), Theorem 7 (1974), pp.175-176
supersedes_notes: The September 4 full rational NS0031 marking exclusion is withdrawn; its norm-one modular arithmetic remains valid.

before_claims.title: NS0031 stable reflection lies outside the rational norm-one period image
before_claims.scope: For the literal NS0031 ternary Gram [[0,0,4],[0,74,1],[4,1,-2]], reflection in v=(0,0,1) is the integral isometry R=[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[4,1,-1]], with determinant -1, trivial discriminant action and a pointwise fixed positive definite two-plane. It therefore belongs to O^+(T)^*. In the retained split even Clifford embedding, its projective period action is represented by A=[[0,-1],[37,0]], which normalizes the integral order and has determinant 37. The explicit trace-zero identification proves that any other rational matrix inducing the same action is a scalar multiple of A; no such matrix has determinant one. Thus the full stable period group is not contained in the projective image of rational norm-one units, contrary to the NS0031 September 4 proof. This is an exact counter-witness to that containment and its asserted period-induced map, not a rational K3 construction or a decision about rational marking existence, which remains UNKNOWN.
dependencies: external: I. Dolgachev, Mirror symmetry for lattice polarized K3 surfaces, arXiv:alg-geom/9502005v2, Proposition 3.3 and the following period quotient
supersedes_notes: A full rational NS marking allows one to restrict its period group to rational norm-one units without checking all stable orthogonal components.

For every row the classifier checks the NS=U+W(-1) rank, signature, determinant, evenness, minimum, and Smith invariants against the catalogue's primitive ternary K3 complement T; imports the exact rational even-Clifford algebra and integral-order ledger; and separates its coarse norm-one curve from the full stable discriminant-kernel marking curve. Hash-pinned decision records classify the determinant-948 NS0001 control as ARITHMETICALLY_POSSIBLE by its exact QQ equation, seventeen rational sections, rho=19, saturation, and trivial torsion; classify determinants 500 and 750, determinant-720 Golay, determinant-950 NS0024 as ARITHMETICALLY_EXCLUDED by the retained modular obstructions; and retain 61 rows as UNKNOWN, including NS0031 after its period-group containment was refuted. Within those 61, determinant 1236 has the stronger exact Phase-2 status UNRESOLVED_FOR_EXPLICIT_REASON: EC-K3-DET1236-MARKED-SHIMURA-CURVE identifies its genus-six X_0^6(103)/<w_618> curve, EC-K3-DET1236-GENUS2-RATIONAL-POINTS proves that its genus-two quotient has exactly fourteen rational points, EC-K3-DET1236-RATIONAL-CM-LOCUS proves that the marked curve has exactly ten rational CM points, and EC-K3-DET1236-CANDIDATE-DOUBLE-COVER gives eight conditional non-fixed rational lifts which the complete CM locus forces all to be CM. Its current 821-row arithmetic queue has no new positive handoff; determinants 256 and 512 are the globally earliest unscreened rows, while the rootless subqueue has 61 UNKNOWN rows. Primary completion requires a different-NS characteristic-zero elliptic K3 over QQ with geometric Picard rank 19, nineteen rational divisor classes, a target-free primitive-nef rootless U', seventeen displayed QQ(t)-sections generating the saturated torsion-free MW lattice, and additionally a certified positive-rank low-genus carrier C/QQ with a nonconstant map to P1 and an exact independent pullback section.
